project_type: Node/Express 4 server (CommonJS) + vanilla-JS PWA in public/, MySQL (mysql2/promise) with express-session + express-mysql-session; Polish UI. Entry point server.js (no exports, calls startServer() at require time). Routers in routes/, helpers in lib/.
language: JavaScript (CommonJS), Node v24.11.0 locally; Dockerfile node:18-alpine; package engines >=16
build_system: No compile step. npm scripts: start = node server.js. Windows + PowerShell: use ';' not '&&'. OneDrive repo: retry any 'cloud file provider exited unexpectedly' error. Worktree is .worktrees/harden-server-1 on branch fix/harden-server-1 (base 91e02a6); node_modules already installed in the worktree.
test_framework: Playwright e2e only (tests/e2e/*.spec.js, config playwright.config.js, demo-mode server started by tests/helpers/start-demo-server.js with OFFLINE_MODE=true NODE_ENV=development, free port, SESSION_SECRET=e2e-fixed-secret). No unit-test runner; use temporary node scripts (named tmp-*.js in the worktree root, deleted afterwards, never committed).

contribution_requirements: Conventional Commits, imperative subject <=50 chars, body wrapped at 72, one commit per FEAT (git add specific files by name; git -P for log/diff). Build/verify before committing. No SIM URL was supplied - omit the sim: trailer. Inclusive language (no master/slave/whitelist/blacklist). Out of scope and must stay untouched: secret values, 413 message/limit mismatch, demo-mode 500s on GET /api/recipients/:id and POST /api/user/identify, unread-count inconsistency, formularz lazy ALTER TABLE, dead code/unused path dep, CSP/helmet/rate-limit, anything in public/.
key_patterns: Routers use `const router = express.Router()` and `module.exports = router` (presents/auth/recipients export { router, lateRouter }). Auth via requireAuth from lib/auth.js. Errors via lib/http-errors.js (badRequest, handleDbError...). DEMO_MODE / pool from lib/db.js (DEMO_MODE true when DEMO_MODE=true, OFFLINE_MODE=true or no DB_PASSWORD). Route order is load-bearing: server.js mounts routers in the original registration order; the ordered route list (66 routes) must stay byte-identical. Logs are plain console.log/console.error with emoji tags.
directory_structure: server.js (entry, middleware, router mounts, error handler, startServer); routes/ (system, pages, auth, recipients, presents, notifications, leaderboard, chat, formularz, archive); lib/ (webpush-config, db, http-errors, auth, cache, update-tracker, queries, presence, push, notifications, leaderboard, chat, link-preview, demo-data, cron); public/ (static PWA - DO NOT TOUCH); tests/e2e + tests/helpers (Playwright); scripts/ (db utilities); .agents/tasks/ (workflow artifacts); docs/archive/.
